key_result: On 66 million agent transactions across 16 blockchains, manipulating the proposed ratings cost 20% of buyers' spend, about 23 times harder than collaborative filtering.
takeaway: Derives provider ratings for agent marketplaces from onchain payment histories, resistant to fake-account (Sybil) manipulation.
title: Anduin: A sybil-resistant agentic marketplace reputation system
why_it_matters: Agents choosing service providers need reputation that does not depend on human reviews or identity credentials.
